cells.name: Dynalene Temperature at the Utility Trunk and Top-End Chiller Dew Point Temperature

queries.query: SELECT mean("CoolPipeSplyTemp") AS "Mean Dynalene Temperature at UT" FROM "lsst.MTCamera"."autogen"."lsst.MTCamera.utiltrunk_ut" WHERE time > :dashboardTime: AND time < :upperDashboardTime: GROUP BY time(:interval:) FILL(null)

SELECT
  (
    243.12 *
      (
        log(mean("ambientRelativeHumiditySensor0502") / 100, exp(1)) +
        (17.62 * mean("ambientTemperatureSensor0502")) /
        (243.12 + mean("ambientTemperatureSensor0502"))
      )
  ) /
  (
    17.62 -
      (
        log(mean("ambientRelativeHumiditySensor0502") / 100, exp(1)) +
        (17.62 * mean("ambientTemperatureSensor0502")) /
        (243.12 + mean("ambientTemperatureSensor0502"))
      )
  )
  AS "502dewpoint"
FROM "efd"."autogen"."lsst.sal.MTMount.topEndChiller"
WHERE
  time > :dashboardTime:
  AND time < :upperDashboardTime:
GROUP BY time(:interval:)
FILL(null)

cells.name: Delta[Dynalene UT Temp - Top End Chiller Dew Point] (remain alert if < -2ºC)

queries.query:
import "math"

dynalene =
  from(bucket: "lsst.MTCamera/autogen")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "lsst.MTCamera.utiltrunk_ut" and
      r._field == "CoolPipeSplyTemp"
    )
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> rename(columns: {_value: "dynalene_temp"})
    |> keep(columns: ["_time", "dynalene_temp"])

dewpoint =
  from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "lsst.sal.MTMount.topEndChiller" and
      (r._field == "ambientTemperatureSensor0502" or
       r._field == "ambientRelativeHumiditySensor0502")
    )
    |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
    |> pivot(
      rowKey: ["_time"],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => {
        alpha =
          math.log(x: r.ambientRelativeHumiditySensor0502 / 100.0) +
          (17.62 * r.ambientTemperatureSensor0502) /
          (243.12 + r.ambientTemperatureSensor0502)

        return {
          _time: r._time,
          dewpoint:
            (243.12 * alpha) /
            (17.62 - alpha)
        }
    })

join(
  tables: {d: dynalene, dp: dewpoint},
  on: ["_time"],
  method: "inner"
)
|> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    "Dynalene UT Temp - Top End Chiller Dew Point": r.dynalene_temp - r.dewpoint
}))
|> yield(name: "Dynalene_minus_Dewpoint")
